summary: Ran frontend-only tests on the preview for the Home/Landing fix. All requested checks passed. (1) With clerk-js blocked (*clerk.browser.js*, *.clerk.accounts.dev/**), the auth-failed banner shows and the landing renders fully: one hero, one pricing block, and the h1 'Go Live Faster...'. (2) With clerk-js delayed 5s, sampled every second for 10s: exactly one hero every time, no duplicate, no connecting or failed state, and the header ends on 'Sign in with Google'. (3) A Clerk-ticket user lands on /dashboard, and opening / redirects to /dashboard with no landing hero in any sample. (4) Regression: blocking /api/clerk/config shows the Retry notice; Retry recovers to the landing with no page reload. A clean load has zero console errors.

issues: The header shows only the logo and no Sign-in button. This is expected because Header uses <Show>. The banner offers a reload, so this is minor and acceptable.

action_items: Optional: in the failed state, the hero CTA 'Start streaming with Google' cannot work. Consider disabling it or pointing it to reload.
Proceed with the production redeploy, then check that www.creatorlive247.com redirects to the apex domain and that the old assets.creatorlive247.sh and PostHog scripts are gone.
critical_code_review_comments: Home: ClerkLoading, ClerkFailed and Show signed-out are mutually exclusive, so only one Landing is ever mounted. Landing remounts once at the loading-to-loaded switch, which is harmless.
The ERR_FAILED console entries in the retry test come only from the config requests the test deliberately blocked.
